name: strip-shows-command
breaks: The shell status shows the command's first two words again, so shell syntax reaches the owner's strip.

name: flag-shown-twice
breaks: The watch forgets which flags it has shown, so the same note comes back after the owner dismissed it.

name: watch-never-backs-off
breaks: Typing past notes never backs the watch off, so every stop costs a look however often the owner ignores it.

name: stale-check-wins
breaks: An older check run's answer rewrites the newer card the owner is looking at.

name: flag-replaces-card
breaks: A watch flag replaces the briefing card instead of waiting for the row.

name: stop-never-marked
breaks: A stop or a question never marks the row, so the owner is not told the session needs a look.

name: note-over-other-mod
breaks: The rep's note draws on top of another mod's note, putting two sets of digit buttons on screen.

name: digits-doubled
breaks: The row keeps its digit hotkeys while another mod draws, so one digit presses two buttons.

name: sessions-unbounded
breaks: The store keeps every session ever seen instead of the newest SESSIONS_MAX.

name: card-overflows-band
breaks: The briefing card is never folded to the band's rows, so a long card pushes its buttons out of the window where a digit cannot press them.

name: size-figure-dropped
breaks: The brief never gets the conversation's size from the engine, so the rep judges length by impression.

name: whole-ask-rule-dropped
breaks: The brief loses the rule that the owner's messages add up, so the rep judges the last message alone.

name: helper-not-counted
breaks: A helper the agent starts is never counted, so the status hides that helpers are running.

name: box-text-overwritten
breaks: The message is put into a prompt box that already has text in it, overwriting what the owner was typing.

name: fill-refusal-ignored
breaks: A prompt box that refuses the message is treated as having taken it, so the card closes and the owner is told it is there.

name: goal-prefix-dropped
breaks: Fix the goal puts the bare sentence in the prompt box, so pressing Enter sends it to the agent instead of pinning it.

name: check-timeout-unreported
breaks: A check that outlasts its five minutes is stopped but reported as having failed to run, not as timed out.

name: check-failure-swallowed
breaks: A check whose run cannot start leaves the card saying it is still checking.

name: end-not-saved
breaks: The session end does not save the record, so a session that ends without a prompt loses its record's freshness.
